Given no requests, a form request or a request of the wrong version, when an error is built, then McpPayloadError is raised
note: boundary: 要求の列が空

test: Given error data, when checked, then each entry must be a URL request
Given a legacy client, when it pings, then it gets an empty result
Given the specification's discover request, when it is answered, then the result describes the server
Given no initialize, when a 2026-07-28 tools/list arrives, then it is served and the server keeps no handshake state
note: edge: initialize が無いまま 2026-07-28 の要求が来る (握手の状態を持たない)

test: Given a 2026-07-28 request without client capabilities, when it is answered, then it is invalid params
Given a request naming an unknown version, when it is answered, then the error lists the supported versions
Given a server limited to a legacy version, when a 2026-07-28 discover probe arrives, then it answers method not found
Given an initialized legacy client, when it lists tools, then the result carries no 2026-07-28 fields
Given one server, when a legacy client and a 2026-07-28 client use it in turn, then each is answered in its own era
note: edge: 1 つの server に旧版と 2026-07-28 の client が交互に来る

test: Given a 2026-07-28 server, when the client connects, then it discovers the server and sends no initialize
Given a connected 2026-07-28 client, when it sends a request, then the request carries the protocol metadata beside its own params
Given a server limited to a legacy version, when a 2026-07-28 client connects, then it falls back to initialize
note: edge: 旧版だけの server に 2026-07-28 の client が接続して initialize へ戻る (版による形の違い)

test: Given a peer that never answers the discover probe, when the probe times out, then the client sends initialize
note: edge: probe が答えられずにタイムアウトする

test: Given a modern peer that supports only a version the client does not speak, when the client connects, then connect fails naming that version and no initialize is sent
Given a discover result that lists no version the client speaks, when the client connects, then connect fails
Given a 2026-07-28 request for a method the version removed, when it is answered, then it is method not found
Given a 2026-07-28 request for an unknown method, when it is answered, then it is method not found
Given a result with a resultType the client does not know, when a request completes, then the client raises instead of returning it
Given a result without resultType from an older server, when a request completes, then it is returned as complete
note: edge: 古い server の結果に resultType が無い (complete として返す)

test: Given no initialize, when a 2026-07-28 tools/list arrives, then it is served and the server keeps no handshake state
note: edge: initialize が無いまま 2026-07-28 の要求が来る。MCP-LIFECYCLE-6 の行と同じテスト (ID ごとの区別なし)

test: Given a 2026-07-28 tools/call, when it is answered, then the result is complete and carries no cache fields
Given an initialized legacy client, when it lists tools, then the result carries no 2026-07-28 fields
note: MCP-LIFECYCLE-8 の行と同じテスト (ID ごとの区別なし)

test: Given a modern peer that answers the probe only after the probe timed out, when it then refuses initialize as unsupported, then the client discovers again and stays modern
note: edge: probe の答えがタイムアウト後に遅れて届く

test: Given a peer that refuses initialize as unsupported though the probe was answered with a legacy error, when the client connects, then connect fails
Given a peer that refuses the probe naming a modern version the client speaks, when the client connects, then it probes again and connects in the modern era
note: edge: probe が拒否されて版を示され、再 probe で接続する

test: Given a peer that refuses the probe twice naming a modern version, when the client connects, then connect fails and no initialize is sent
note: boundary: probe の再試行の上限 (2 回目の拒否で失敗、initialize は送らない)

test: Given a peer that refuses the probe naming only legacy versions, when the client connects, then it sends initialize and does not probe again
Given a discover result that lists only legacy versions, when the client connects, then it sends initialize
Given a peer that refuses the probe as unsupported without naming versions, when the client connects, then connect fails saying no version is shared
Given a peer silent to the probe that refuses initialize with another error naming a modern version, when the client connects, then connect fails without discovering again
note: edge: probe に答えが無く、initialize が別のエラーで拒否される

test: Given a transport that never finishes sending the probe, when the probe times out, then the client cancels it, leaves nothing pending and sends initialize
note: edge: probe の送信が終わらないままタイムアウトする

test: Given a byte order mark after the first line, when read, then it stays part of that line's field name
note: edge: 先頭ではない位置の BOM (欄名の一部に残る)

test: Given blank lines after an event, when read, then they dispatch nothing more
note: edge: イベント後に空行が続く (送り出すものが無い)

test: Given a line of exactly the limit, when read, then it is accepted and one byte more raises SseLimitError
note: boundary: 1 行の上限ちょうどは受理、1 バイト超過で SseLimitError

test: Given identifiers with a reverse-DNS prefix, when validated, then they are accepted
Given identifiers without a prefix or with a malformed one, when validated, then they are rejected
Given the specification's client and server capability examples, when parsed and written, then they round-trip
Given capabilities with no extensions or a non-object value, when read, then no extensions are declared
note: edge: extensions が無い、または object でない値の capabilities

test: Given labels and names with digits and hyphens in every position the rules allow, when validated, then they are accepted
note: boundary: 数字とハイフンが規則の許す位置の端 (ラベルの先頭が英字の後、名前の先頭が数字など) に来る識別子

test: Given capabilities that are nil, lack the extension or hold settings that are not an object, when read, then nothing is declared
note: edge: nil、該当の拡張が無い、設定が object でない capabilities

test: Given a registered extension, when a 2026-07-28 client discovers the server, then the capabilities list it with its settings
Given a registered extension, when a legacy client initializes, then the capabilities do not mention extensions
note: edge: 旧版の握手では extensions を載せない (版による違い)

test: Given a client that declares the extension, when it calls an extension method, then the handler runs and sees the settings
Given a client that does not declare the extension, when it calls an extension method, then it gets the missing-capability error naming the extension
Given a handler that uses ctx.requireClientExtension, when the client lacks the extension, then the answer is the missing-capability error
Given a version without extensions, when an extension method is called, then it is method not found
Given an extension that defines a resultType, when its handler returns it, then the result passes through unchanged
Given a handler that returns a resultType no extension defines, when it answers, then it is an internal error
Given a tool whose result carries an extension's resultType, when the client did not declare that extension, then the answer is the missing-capability error naming it
Given a tool whose result has a resultType that is not a string, when it answers, then it is an internal error
Given bad registrations, when made, then each raises ValueError
Given a result type that one extension registered, when another extension registers it, then it raises ValueError, and the owner may register it again
note: edge: 結果型の持ち主が同じ登録をもう一度行う (許される)

test: Given a declared extension, when a request is sent, then clientCapabilities carries it
Given a declared extension, when the client initializes in a legacy version, then the capabilities do not mention extensions
note: edge: 旧版の握手では宣言済みの拡張を載せない (版による違い)

test: Given a connected client, when it declares an extension, then it raises because capabilities are fixed at connect
Given a server that declares an extension, when the client connects, then it can read the server's settings
Given a server without the extension, when the client calls an extension method, then it raises McpUnsupportedError and sends nothing
Given a client that did not declare the extension, when it calls an extension method, then it raises McpUnsupportedError
Given a legacy connection on which both sides declared the extension, when the client calls an extension method, then it raises McpUnsupportedError and sends nothing
Given both sides support the extension, when the server answers with the extension's resultType, then the client returns the result
Given a resultType the client's extensions do not define, when the server answers with it, then the client raises
Given extensions registered without onLegacyHandshake, when a legacy client initializes, then the request and the result are those of a peer with no extensions
note: edge: 旧版の握手で onLegacyHandshake を付けない拡張は、拡張の無い相手と同じ要求・結果になる

test: Given an extension declared with onLegacyHandshake, when a legacy client initializes, then the request carries it and only it
Given a legacy client that declared an extension in initialize, when a handler asks, then it sees the settings; without the declaration it does not
Given a legacy client, when a handler reads what the client declared, then only the extensions are carried over and nothing known is JSON null
note: edge: 旧版の client の宣言は拡張だけが引き継がれ、拡張が無ければ JSON null

test: Given an extension registered with onLegacyHandshake, when a legacy client initializes, then the result announces it and only it
Given an extension the server alone declares, when a client that declared nothing calls its method, then the server serves it and the client sends it
note: edge: client が何も宣言しないまま server だけが宣言した拡張を呼ぶ

test: Given a server that declares a capability the core does not define, when the client connects, then serverCapability returns its settings and only those
note: edge: 非 object の値 (flag: true) やコアが定める名前は serverCapability が返さない

test: Given a server that declares only capabilities the core defines, when the client connects, then it has none of another kind
note: edge: コアが定める capability だけを宣言する server (追加の種類が無い)

test: Given a server whose capabilities are not an object, when the client connects, then it connects and the server declared nothing
note: edge: capabilities が object でない server (宣言なしとして接続する)

test: Given a top-level capability registered with settings, with none and with settings that are not an object, when registered, then the first two are declared to a 2026-07-28 client and the last raises
Given a method of a specification that asks nothing of the client, when a client that declared nothing calls it, then the server serves it
Given an extension method whose handler returns something that is not an object, when it answers, then it is an internal error
Given the tasks extension and another one, when each registers tasks/get, tasks/cancel and other core methods, then only the tasks extension may take over those two
Given a stream cut before the response, when an event id was seen, then the client asks for the events after it and receives the response
note: response 前に切れた stream を Last-Event-ID で再開して応答を受け取る (途中で切れる)

test: Given a stream cut before any event id, when the response is missing, then a local stream-closed error stands in for it and nothing is resumed
note: event id を見る前に切れると再開せず local の stream-closed error が応答の代わり (途中で切れる)

test: Given a server that cuts every stream before saying anything, when the client has resumed as often as it may, then the stream-closed error stands in for the response
note: 毎回何も言わず切る server に対し再開の上限 (maxReconnects=2) ちょうどで諦め stream-closed error

test: Given a server that answers the resumption with 404, when the stream was cut, then the client stops resuming and reports the stream closed
note: 再開要求が 404 なら再開をやめ stream closed を報告

test: Given a version without resumption, when the stream was cut, then nothing is resumed
note: 再開を持たない版 (2024-11-05) では切れても再開しない (版による違い)

test: Given a server that asked for a delay with retry, when the stream was cut, then the client waits at least that long before resuming
note: [迷い] server の retry: 150 を守り再開まで 140ms 以上待つ (待ち時間の下限)

test: Given an event with an id and no data, when it arrives, then it is not a message and not an error
note: id だけで data の無い event は message でもエラーでもない (priming event)

test: Given an initialized session, when the server says something outside any request, then the client receives it
note: 初期化済み session で要求の外の server 発話を受け取る

test: Given a request the server sends on the GET stream, when the client answers it, then the server receives the answer
note: GET stream 上の server 要求に client が応答すると server が受け取る

test: Given a GET stream that is cut, when the client reconnects, then it names the last event id it saw
note: 切れた GET stream の再接続で最後に見た event id を Last-Event-ID に載せる (途中で切れる)

test: Given a server without a GET stream, when the session is initialized, then the client asks once and does not ask again
note: GET stream を持たない server (405) には 1 回だけ尋ねて再び尋ねない

test: Given a version without a GET stream, when the session is initialized, then the client does not open one
note: GET stream の無い版では開かない (版による違い)

test: Given a client told not to listen, when the session is initialized, then it does not open a GET stream
note: listenForServerMessages=false の client は GET を開かない (設定による違い)

test: Given a session, when the client closes, then it sends DELETE with the session id and the server forgets it
note: close で session id つき DELETE を送り server が session を忘れる

test: Given a server that refuses DELETE with 405, when the client closes, then closing succeeds
note: DELETE を 405 で拒む server でも close は成功

test: Given no session, when the client closes, then it sends no DELETE
note: session が無ければ DELETE を送らない (任意の状態が無い)

test: Given a GET stream open, when the client closes, then the stream ends and the server sees the client leave
note: GET stream が開いている状態で close すると stream が終わり server が離脱を知る

test: Given a request, when the client posts it, then Accept lists both application/json and text/event-stream
note: POST の Accept が application/json と text/event-stream の両方

test: Given a client opening the GET stream, when it asks, then Accept lists text/event-stream
note: GET の Accept が text/event-stream

test: Given a request whose answer was a JSON body, when the client cancels it afterwards and sends the id again, then the new request is not taken for a cancelled one
note: JSON 本体で応答済みの要求を後で cancel し同じ id を再送しても cancel 済み扱いにしない (同じ id の再使用)

test: Given a request whose answer was an event stream, when the client cancels it afterwards and sends the id again, then the new request is not taken for a cancelled one
note: event stream で応答済みの要求の cancel 後に同じ id を再送 (同じ id の再使用)

test: Given a request that failed after the connection was made, when the client cancels it afterwards and sends the id again, then the new request is not taken for a cancelled one
note: 接続後に失敗した要求の cancel 後に同じ id を再送 (同じ id の再使用)

test: Given a request cancelled while the server was silent, when the id is sent again, then the new request is not taken for a cancelled one
note: server が黙っている間に cancel した id の再使用 (同じ id の再使用・途中で切れる)

test: Given a request cancelled while its JSON body is arriving, when the client cancels, then sendRequest returns without an error and the id is free again
note: JSON 本体の到着途中で cancel しても sendRequest はエラーなしで返り id が空く (途中で切れる)

test: Given a request whose event stream is open, when the transport closes, then the server sees the client leave
note: event stream が開いている状態で transport を閉じると server が離脱を知る

test: Given a server that answers a notification with 202 and an empty body, when the notification is sent, then the client closes the connection
note: 通知に 202 と空本体が返ると client が接続を閉じる

test: Given a server that answers DELETE with 204 and no body, when the client closes, then the client closes the connection
note: DELETE に 204 で本体なしが返っても client が接続を閉じる (本体なし)

test: Given a client that says initialized twice, when the GET stream is already open, then it does not open a second one
note: initialized を 2 回言っても GET stream を 2 本目は開かない (同じものが 2 回来る)

test: Given a server that answers DELETE with 500, when the client closes, then the refusal is logged and closing succeeds
note: DELETE が 500 のとき拒否をログに残し close は成功

test: Given a server that answers DELETE with 204 or 405, when the client closes, then nothing is logged
note: DELETE が 204 または 405 のときは何もログしない (期待どおりの拒否)

test: Given a server that drops the connection on DELETE, when the client closes, then the failure is logged and closing succeeds
note: DELETE で接続を落とす server に対し失敗をログに残し close は成功

test: Given a server that answers a notification with an event stream, when the stream ends, then its messages were delivered and the client goes on
note: 通知への応答として event stream を返す server でも messages を届けて client は続行 (仕様外の珍しい応答)

test: Given a request whose stream already carried an event id, when the client cancels it, then the stream is not asked for again and no answer arrives
note: event id を運んだ stream の要求を cancel すると再開要求せず応答も来ない (cancel と再開の競合)

test: Given a request whose stream was cut after an event id, when the client cancels it before the stream is asked for again, then it is not asked for and no answer arrives
note: 切れた後で再開前に cancel すると再開せず応答も来ない (cancel と再開の競合)

test: Given a body exactly as long as the limit, when a request is sent, then the response is delivered
note: 応答本体の長さがちょうど上限 (maxResponseSize) でも届く

test: Given an HTTP error whose JSON body has an error but no jsonrpc version, when a request is sent, then it is a transport error with the status
note: jsonrpc 版の無い error 本体を持つ HTTP エラーは status つきの transport error

test: Given an HTTP error whose JSON body is no object, when a request is sent, then it is a transport error with the status
note: JSON 本体がオブジェクトでない HTTP エラーも status つきの transport error (配列本体)

test: Given a stream that carries the response and then ends, when the response was read, then nothing else is delivered
note: 応答を運んで終わった stream は以降何も届けない

test: Given a stream that carries the response to another request, when it ends without its own, then the stream-closed error is delivered
note: 別要求の応答だけ運んで終わった stream は stream-closed error を届ける

test: Given a stream with a request of the server that has the id of the posted request, when it ends without the response, then the stream-closed error is delivered
note: 送った要求と同じ id を持つ server 要求だけで終わる stream は stream-closed error (id の衝突)

test: Given a request whose event stream is open, when the client closes, then no stream-closed error is delivered
note: event stream が開いたまま client が閉じても stream-closed error は届けない

test: Given an id that was cancelled while its stream was open, when the id is used again and its stream breaks, then the stream-closed error is delivered
note: stream 中に cancel した id を再使用し stream が壊れると stream-closed error (同じ id の再使用)

test: Given a resumed stream that carries the response, when it ends, then the client neither asks again nor delivers a stream-closed error
note: 応答を運んだ再開 stream が終わっても再問い合わせも stream-closed error も無い

test: Given an event that is no JSON, when it arrives on the stream of a request, then the client says the stream failed and closes the connection
note: JSON でない event は stream 失敗として記録し接続を閉じる

test: Given a server that answers the GET with 200 and no event stream, when the session is initialized, then the client asks once, says so and closes the connection
note: GET が 200 だが event stream でない場合は 1 回だけ尋ね、記録し、接続を閉じる

test: Given a server that answers the GET with 405, when the session is initialized, then the client closes the connection and logs nothing
note: GET が 405 の server では接続を閉じ何も記録しない (GET を提供しない server)

test: Given a server that hangs up on the GET, when the session is initialized, then the client logs the failure once and does not ask again
note: GET で hang up する server の失敗を 1 回だけ記録し再び尋ねない

test: Given an event that is no JSON on the GET stream, when it arrives, then the client says the stream failed
note: GET stream 上の JSON でない event を stream 失敗として記録

test: Given a GET stream that is open, when the client closes, then the connection of the stream is closed
note: 開いている GET stream の接続を close で閉じる

test: Given a GET stream still being opened, when the client closes, then the connection of that stream is closed as well
note: GET stream を開いている最中の close でもその接続を閉じる (同時に起きる)

test: Given a negotiated version that has the header, when the client posts, opens the GET stream and ends the session, then each request names the version
note: ヘッダを持つ版では POST・GET・DELETE がすべて版を名指す

test: Given a resumed stream whose events carry no id, when it is cut too, then the next resumption still names the last id that was sent
note: 再開した stream の event に id が無くても次の再開は最後に送られた id を名指す (id の欠落)

test: Given a server that says something on every resumed stream, when the stream is cut more often than the limit, then the response still arrives
note: 再開の上限 (maxReconnects=2) を超えて切れても、server が毎回何か言えば応答が届く (回数の数え直し)

test: Given a server that ends every GET stream at once, when the session is initialized, then the client asks once and as often again as it may reconnect
note: 毎回すぐ閉じる GET stream への再接続は最初の 1 回と上限 maxReconnects=2 回の計 3 回

test: Given a GET stream cut after a message, when the client reconnects, then it waits for the reconnect delay
note: [迷い] GET stream の再接続前に reconnect delay (150ms) 以上待つ (待ち時間の下限)

test: Given GET streams whose later events carry no id, when each is cut, then every reconnection names the last id that was sent
note: 後続 event に id が無い GET stream でも再接続は最後に送られた id を名指す (id の欠落)

test: Given a GET stream that is open, when the client is initialized again, then it does not open a second stream
note: GET stream が開いている間に再度 initialized されても 2 本目を開かない (同じものが 2 回来る)

test: Given a GET stream that ended because the server offers none, when the client is initialized again, then it asks again
note: server が GET を提供せず終わった後に再度 initialized されると再び尋ねる

test: Given a document without an ETag, when a client GETs it with If-None-Match, then it is served whole and no ETag is sent
note: ETag を持たない文書は If-None-Match があっても 304 にならず全文を返す (検証子が無い)

test: Given a GET on the SSE path, when answered, then it is an event stream whose first event names the endpoint
note: SSE path への GET は event stream で最初の event が endpoint を名指す

test: Given two connections, when each is answered, then the endpoints differ
note: 接続ごとに endpoint が異なる

test: Given a request posted to the endpoint, when the server answers, then the POST gets 202 and the answer arrives on the stream
note: endpoint への POST は 202 で応答は stream に届く

test: Given a request during which the server sent a notification, when posted, then both arrive on the stream in order
note: 通知と応答が順番どおり stream に届く

test: Given two clients using the same request id, when both are answered, then each answer reaches the right stream
note: 2 クライアントが同じ request id を使っても応答は正しい stream に届く (同じ id)

test: Given two requests in progress at once, when the server answers them one after the other, then each answer carries the id its own request chose
note: 同時進行の 2 要求を 1 つずつ応答しても各応答は自分の id を持つ (同時に起きる)

test: Given a notification the server sends to every client, when two connections are open, then each hears it
note: 全 client 宛て通知を 2 接続がそれぞれ聞く

test: Given a request the server sends, when the client answers by POST, then the server receives the answer
note: server 要求への client の POST 応答を server が受け取る

test: Given a POST naming no session or an unknown one, when posted, then the answer is 400 or 404
note: session 無し・未知 session の POST は 400 または 404

test: Given a POST that is not a JSON object, when posted, then the answer is 400
note: JSON オブジェクトでない POST (配列) は 400

test: Given a POST whose body is not JSON, when posted, then the answer is 400
note: JSON でない本体の POST は 400

test: Given a client that closes its stream, when the server notices, then the session ends and its endpoint is gone
note: stream を閉じると session が終わり endpoint は 404 になる

test: Given the session limit, when another client connects, then the answer is 503
note: session 数の上限 (maxSessions=1) に達した後の接続は 503

test: Given a foreign Origin, when it connects or posts, then the answer is 403
note: 外部 Origin の接続・POST は 403

test: Given a stream, when its head is read, then it carries the security headers
note: stream の head に security headers

test: Given this SDK's server, when the client sends a request, then the answer and the related notification arrive through receiveMessage
note: SDK の server に要求すると応答と関連通知が receiveMessage に届く

test: Given a connected client, when the server sends a request and the client answers, then the server receives the answer
note: server 要求に client が応答すると server が受け取る

test: Given a client that sends a notification first, when it connects, then the notification reaches the server
note: 通知を最初に送る client でも接続して通知が server に届く (順序)

test: Given headers set on the transport, when it connects and posts, then both requests carry them
note: transport に設定した headers が接続と POST の両方に載る

test: Given an endpoint event naming another host, when the client connects, then it refuses to post there
note: 別 host を名指す endpoint event には POST を拒否

test: Given a server that never sends an endpoint, when the client connects, then it gives up with McpTransportError
note: endpoint を送らない server には McpTransportError で諦める (connectTimeout)

test: Given a server that answers the stream request with 404, when the client connects, then McpTransportError carries the status
note: stream 要求への 404 は status つきの McpTransportError

test: Given a stream that ends, when the client waits for a message, then McpTransportClosedError is raised
note: stream が終わった後の receive は McpTransportClosedError

test: Given a closed client, when it sends, then McpTransportError is raised
note: close 済みの client の送信は McpTransportError

test: Given a server of the old transport, when a client given its SSE URL connects, then it falls back and works
note: 旧 transport の server に SSE URL で接続すると fallback して動く (フォールバック)

test: Given a Streamable HTTP server, when a client connects, then it uses Streamable HTTP
note: Streamable HTTP の server には Streamable HTTP を使う

test: Given headers set on the wrapper, when it falls back, then the old transport carries them too
note: wrapper に設定した headers は fallback 先の旧 transport も運ぶ (フォールバック)

test: Given a server that is down, when a client connects, then the connection error is raised and no fallback is tried
note: server が落ちていれば接続エラーを上げ fallback しない

test: Given a full client and server, when the client connects through the wrapper to the old transport, then initialize and tools/list work
note: wrapper 経由で旧 transport に接続し initialize と tools/list が動く

test: Given the SSE endpoint switched off, when a client posts to the messages path, then the answer is 404
note: SSE endpoint を無効にすると messages path への POST は 404

test: Given the messages path, when a client sends GET, then the answer is 405 naming POST
note: messages path への GET は 405 で POST を名指す

test: Given an endpoint on the same host and port under another scheme, when the client connects, then it refuses it as another origin
note: scheme だけ違う同 host・同 port の endpoint は別 origin として拒否

test: Given an endpoint on another host at the same port, when the client connects, then it refuses it as another origin
note: 同 port で別 host の endpoint は別 origin として拒否

test: Given an endpoint on the same host at another port, when the client connects, then it refuses it as another origin
note: 同 host で別 port の endpoint は別 origin として拒否

test: Given an endpoint on another origin while the stream stays open, when the client connects, then it fails at once and says why
note: stream が開いたままでも別 origin の endpoint で即座に失敗し理由を述べる

test: Given a stream that ends before it names an endpoint, when the client connects, then it fails at once and says so
note: endpoint を名乗る前に stream が終わると即座に失敗 (途中で切れる)

test: Given events that are not messages, when the client reads the stream, then it skips them and delivers the next message
note: message でない event (ping) は読み飛ばして次の message を届ける

test: Given message events without data, when the client reads the stream, then it skips them and delivers the next message
note: data の無い message event は読み飛ばして次の message を届ける (空)

test: Given a stream that ended some time ago, when the client then waits for a message, then McpTransportClosedError is raised at once
note: しばらく前に終わった stream での receive は即座に McpTransportClosedError (途中で切れる)

test: Given a stream that fails on a message that is not JSON, when the client has read it, then it closes its end of the connection
note: JSON でない message で壊れた stream は client 側の接続を閉じる

test: Given a server answering the stream request with 404, when the client gives up, then it closes its end of the connection
note: stream 要求への 404 で諦めるとき client 側の接続を閉じる

test: Given a server answering the stream request with something that is no event stream, when the client gives up, then it closes its end of the connection
note: event stream でない応答で諦めるとき client 側の接続を閉じる

test: Given a server that names no endpoint in time, when the client gives up, then it closes its end of the stream before it is closed itself
note: endpoint が時間内に来ず諦めるとき自分で閉じられる前に stream の自分側を閉じる

test: Given a POST the server answered, when the client has read the answer, then it closes its end of the POST connection
note: 応答を受けた POST の接続を client が閉じる

test: Given a connected client, when it is closed, then it closes its end of the stream
note: 接続中の client を close すると stream の自分側を閉じる

test: Given a stream that fails on a message that is not JSON, when the client reads it, then it says so on stderr
note: JSON でない message で壊れた stream を stderr に報告する

test: Given a server of the old transport, when the client sends a notification after falling back, then the server receives it
note: fallback 後の通知が旧 transport の server に届く (フォールバック)

test: Given a server of the old transport, when the client answers a request after falling back, then the server receives the response
note: fallback 後の応答が旧 transport の server に届く (フォールバック)

test: Given a version agreed through the wrapper, when a Streamable HTTP server is used, then later requests name it
note: wrapper を通じて合意した版を Streamable HTTP の後続要求が名指す

test: Given a Streamable HTTP server that issued a session, when the wrapper closes, then the session is ended with DELETE
note: session を発行した Streamable HTTP server に対し wrapper の close で DELETE

test: Given a server of the old transport, when the wrapper closes, then the stream ends and the server's session with it
note: 旧 transport の server に対する wrapper の close で stream と server 側 session が終わる

test: Given a wrapper that has not decided, when it closes while a receive waits, then the receive fails with McpTransportError
note: 未決定の wrapper が受信待ちの間に close すると受信が McpTransportError で失敗 (同時に起きる)

test: Given a request in progress, when the client closes the connection, then the server is told the request was cancelled
note: 進行中の要求でクライアントが接続を閉じると server に cancelled が伝わる (2026-07-28)

test: Given a request in progress with nothing sent yet, when the client closes the connection, then the server is told the request was cancelled
note: まだ何も送っていない段階での切断でも cancelled が伝わる (生の socket で切断)

test: Given a cancelled request, when the server answers it anyway, then the answer is dropped without an error
note: cancel 済みの要求への遅れた応答は黙って捨て、pendingExchangeCount が 0 (遅れて来る応答)

test: Given a request whose connection was cut, when the server finishes it, then it was not treated as cancelled
note: legacy 版では接続が切れても cancel 扱いにしない (版による違い)

test: Given a request during which the server sent notifications, when posted, then the answer is an event stream with the notifications first and the response last
note: 通知があった要求の応答は event stream で通知が先・応答が最後

test: Given a request during which the server sent nothing, when posted, then the answer is a plain JSON body
note: 通知が無ければ素の JSON 本体 (版による応答形式の違い)

test: Given a request during which the server sent notifications, when posted, then the stream carries them and ends with the response
note: 2026-07-28 でも通知を stream で運び応答で終わる

test: Given a response that is ready while the last notification is being written, when posted, then the stream ends with the response without waiting for a keep-alive
note: 最後の通知を書いている最中に応答が準備できる競合でも keep-alive を待たず応答で終わる (同時に起きる)

test: Given a response that is ready while the last notification is being written, when posted, then the stream ends with the response without waiting for a keep-alive (2026-07-28)
Given two requests at once on one session, when each sends notifications, then each stream carries only its own
note: 同一 session の同時 2 要求で各 stream は自分の通知だけ運ぶ (同時に起きる)

test: Given a notification the server sends for a request that is not in progress, when sent, then McpTransportError is raised
note: 進行中でない要求への通知送信は McpTransportError

test: Given an event stream, when its head is read, then it carries the security headers and no caching
note: event stream の head に security headers と no-cache

test: Given an event stream, when its head is read, then proxies are told not to buffer it
note: proxy に buffer しないよう X-Accel-Buffering: no

test: Given an event stream, when its events are read, then every event has an id and the ids differ
note: 各 event に id があり互いに異なる

test: Given a version that primes streams, when a stream opens, then its first event has an id and no data
note: priming する版では最初の event が id だけで data 無し

test: Given a version that does not prime streams, when a stream opens, then its first event is a message
note: priming しない版では最初の event が message (版による違い)

test: Given a stream of 2026-07-28, when its events are read, then it has no priming event
note: 2026-07-28 の stream に priming event が無い

test: Given a stream cut after its first event, when the client asks for the events after that one, then it gets the rest and not the first again
note: 最初の event 後に切れた stream を Last-Event-ID で再開し残りだけ受け取る (途中で切れる)

test: Given a stream of another session, when its event id is presented, then it is not replayed
note: 他 session の event id での再開は 400 で再生しない

test: Given a Last-Event-ID of no stream the server knows, when asked to resume, then the answer is 400
note: 知らない stream の Last-Event-ID は 400

test: Given a Last-Event-ID that is not an event id at all, when asked to resume, then the answer is 400
note: event id の形でない Last-Event-ID は 400

test: Given a stream that remembers one event, when more were sent after the client left, then resuming from an event it forgot is refused
note: 保持 event 数の上限 (maxStreamEvents=1) を超えて忘れた event からの再開は 400

test: Given the GET stream of a session, when the client left after an event and asks for the rest by that event's id, then it gets the later events
note: GET stream で離脱後に event id で再開し後続を受ける (途中で切れる)

test: Given a GET stream that has sent events, when an event id of a stream the session never had is presented, then the answer is 400
note: GET stream が持たない stream の event id は 400

test: Given a transport that was never started, when it is asked, then it is not accepting; listening starts it and close stops it and frees the port
note: listen 前は受付中でなく、listen で開始し close で停止・port 解放

test: Given a posted request, when the server takes it with receiveMessage, then it gets the message
note: POST された要求を receiveMessage で受け取る

test: Given a response stream still open, when its session ends, then the stream ends
note: 応答 stream が開いている間に session が終わると stream も終わる

test: Given a session timeout of 0, when idle sessions are expired long after the last request, then the session stays
note: セッションタイムアウト 0 は期限なし (0 の境目)。長時間後も session が残る

test: Given the session limit is reached by sessions that were used and then went idle, when another client initializes, then an idle one is dropped to make room
note: session 数の上限 (maxSessions=1) に使用済み・放置 session で達したとき放置 session を落として場所を作る

test: Given no limit on sessions per address (0), when a client initializes, then it gets a session
note: アドレスあたり session 数の上限 0 は無制限 (0 の境目)

test: Given a limit of two queued messages and nobody receiving, when two requests are posted, then both are taken and a third is refused
note: キュー上限 2 で 2 件は受理しちょうど 3 件目は 503 で拒否

test: Given a session that keeps one finished stream, when a second request ends, then the first stream can no longer be resumed and the second can
note: 保持する終了済み stream 数の上限 1 で 2 つ目の終了後、1 つ目は再開不可・2 つ目は可

test: Given a session that keeps two finished streams, when a second request ends, then both can be resumed
note: 保持上限 2 のとき 2 つとも再開できる (ちょうど上限)

test: Given two sessions that chose the same request ids, when one cancels its requests, then each notification names that session's own request
note: 2 session が同じ request id を選んでも cancel 通知は各 session 自身の要求を指す (同じものが 2 回来る)

test: Given a subscription stream, when the server sends a notification that names another subscription, then the id is left as it is, and one that names this stream's request is given the client's id
note: 購読 stream で他の購読名はそのまま、この stream の要求名は client の id に置換 (珍しい形)

test: Given a notification whose params is an array, when the server sends it on a request's stream, then it arrives as it was sent
note: params が配列の通知もそのまま届く (珍しい形)

test: Given an initialized session, when a notification is posted on it, then the empty answer carries no Content-Type
note: 通知の POST への空の 202 は Content-Type を持たない

test: Given an initialize answer that names no version, when the session is used, then it is held to the newest version the build speaks and a version header it does not speak is refused
note: initialize 応答が版を名乗らない session はビルドが話す最新版に縛られ、話さない版ヘッダは拒否 (版名なし)

test: Given a session, when the client opens GET, then the server's own notifications arrive on it
note: GET で server 自身の通知が届く

test: Given a notification sent to every client, when two sessions listen, then each hears it once
note: 全 client 宛て通知は 2 session がそれぞれ 1 回聞く

test: Given a notification sent before the client opened GET, when it opens, then the notification is waiting
note: GET を開く前に送った通知が待っている (順序の入れ替わり)

test: Given a request the server sends on the GET stream, when the client answers by POST, then the server receives the answer
note: GET stream 上の server 要求に POST で応答すると server が受け取る

test: Given a second GET on a session, when the first is still open, then the second takes the stream over
note: 先の GET が開いている間の 2 つ目の GET が stream を引き継ぐ (同時に開く)

test: Given a second GET that took the stream over, when a notification is sent, then the first connection ends without carrying it
note: 引き継がれた先の GET は通知を運ばずに終わる (同時に開く)

test: Given a GET without a session id, when sent, then the answer is 400
note: session id の無い GET は 400

test: Given a GET naming an unknown session, when sent, then the answer is 404
note: 未知 session への GET は 404

test: Given a GET that does not accept an event stream, when sent, then the answer is 406
note: event stream を受け付けない GET は 406

test: Given a GET from a foreign Origin, when sent, then the answer is 403
note: 外部の Origin からの GET は 403

test: Given a GET that names a version the server does not speak, when it arrives, then the answer is 400
note: server が話さない版を名指す GET は 400

test: Given a GET open on a session, when the client sends DELETE, then the stream ends
note: DELETE で開いている GET stream が終わる

test: Given a session that expires, when a GET stream is open on it, then the stream ends
note: session が期限切れになると GET stream が終わる

test: Given a 2026-07-28 endpoint, when GET is sent, then no stream opens and the answer is 400 or 405
note: 2026-07-28 では GET で stream が開かず 400 か 405

test: Given a request of 2026-07-28, when the server tries to send a request of its own on its stream, then McpTransportError is raised
note: 2026-07-28 の要求の stream で server 自身の要求を送ると McpTransportError

test: Given a session negotiated at 2024-11-05, when it opens GET, then the answer is 405 naming POST and DELETE
note: 2024-11-05 で交渉した session の GET は 405 で Allow: POST, DELETE (版による違い)

test: Given a session unused for longer than the limit, when idle sessions are expired, then it is gone and the server is told
note: idle 上限を超えた session は消え server に伝わる

test: Given a session in use, when idle sessions are expired, then it stays
note: 使用中の session は残る

test: Given a session with a GET stream open, when it has sent nothing for longer than the limit, then it stays
note: GET stream が開いている session は何も送らなくても残る

test: Given the session limit is reached by idle sessions, when another client initializes, then an idle one is dropped to make room
note: session 数の上限 (1) に idle session で達したとき idle を落として場所を作る

test: Given the transport is serving, when a session stays idle, then it expires without anyone asking
note: serving 中は誰も要求しなくても idle session が期限切れになる

test: Given a session whose GET stream has ended, when it then stays unused, then it stays only for the limit counted from the end of the stream, and then expires
note: GET stream が終わった session は終了時点から数えた期限までは残り、その後期限切れ (期限の境目)

test: Given a session that has served a request, when it then stays unused beyond the limit, then it expires
note: 要求を捌いた session も期限を超えて放置されると期限切れ

test: Given a header naming the negotiated version, when a request is posted, then it is served
note: 交渉した版を名指すヘッダの要求は受理

test: Given a header naming a version nobody released, when a request is posted, then the answer is 400
note: 存在しない版を名指すヘッダは 400

test: Given a header that is not a version, when a request is posted, then the answer is 400
note: 版でないヘッダ値 (latest) は 400

test: Given a header naming a released version newer than the endpoint serves, when a request is posted, then the answer is 400
note: リリース済みだが endpoint が話さない新しい版のヘッダは 400

test: Given no header, when a request is posted, then it is served as the earlier version
note: ヘッダが無ければ前の版として受理 (任意の欄が無い)

test: Given a header on a notification, when it names an unsupported version, then the answer is 400
note: notification でも未対応版のヘッダは 400

test: Given a batch of two requests, when posted, then the answer is an array with a response for each
note: 2 要求の batch は各々に応答する配列で返す

test: Given a batch of requests and notifications, when posted, then only the requests are answered
note: 要求と通知が混在する batch は要求だけ応答 (混在)

test: Given a batch of notifications only, when posted, then the answer is 202 with no body
note: 通知だけの batch は 202 で本体なし

test: Given a batch of responses, when posted, then the answer is 202
note: 応答だけの batch は 202

test: Given a batch whose requests make the server send notifications, when posted, then the answer is a stream with one response per request
note: 通知を伴う要求を含む batch は stream で要求ごとの応答 1 つ

test: Given a batch of a request and a notification, when posted, then the server receives the notification
note: batch 内の通知を server が受け取る

test: Given a batch holding initialize, when posted, then the answer is 400
note: initialize を含む batch は 400

test: Given an empty batch, when posted, then the answer is 400
note: 空の batch は 400 (0 件)

test: Given a batch holding something that is not an object, when posted, then the answer is 400
note: オブジェクトでない要素を持つ batch は 400

test: Given a session of 2025-06-18, when a batch is posted, then the answer is 400
note: 2025-06-18 の session では batch は 400 (-32600)

test: Given a server that never answers, when a client connects, then the probe and the handshake time out instead of waiting forever
note: 応答しない相手に対し probe と handshake が McpTimeoutError で終わる

test: Given a server that never answers, when a request has its own timeout, then McpTimeoutError is raised after it
note: 応答しない相手に対し要求ごとの timeout で McpTimeoutError (handshake 失敗後の要求も)

test: Given a fetch without the server's origin, when asked for a URL, then it is refused
note: 発信元 origin が無い取得は McpIconError で拒否

test: Given nothing but the signature of an image type, when sniffed, then the type is the one the signature says
note: 署名ちょうどの長さ (PNG 8 バイト, JPEG 3, WEBP 12) で型が決まる

test: Given a signature cut short, when sniffed, then there is no type
note: 署名より 1 バイト短い入力と空文字列は型なし

test: Given markup that opens with a comment or a doctype, when it holds an svg element, then it is an SVG
note: 先頭がコメント・doctype・BOM と空白でも svg 要素があれば SVG

test: Given markup that holds no svg element at its start, when sniffed, then it is not an SVG
note: svg 要素が先頭に無い markup (rss, html 内の svg, html) は SVG でない

test: Given a version that has icons, when each list is requested, then the icons are sent as they are
note: icons を持つ版は 4 つの list で icons をそのまま送る

test: Given a resource link with icons, when a version decides, then the icons go where icons do
note: resource link の icons は版で有無が変わる (版ごとの形の違い)

test: Given an icon with only a src, when it is written, then only the src is sent
note: src だけの icon は src だけ書く (任意の欄が無い)

test: Given an icon with every field, when it is written and parsed, then it comes back the same
note: 全欄を持つ icon の書き出しと読み戻しが一致

test: Given a version without icons, when each list is requested, then no icons are sent
note: icons の無い版では icons を送らない (版による形の違い)

test: Given listed items with icons, when the client lists them, then each carries its icons
note: icons つきの項目を list で読むと icons が付く

test: Given an item without icons, when the client lists it, then it has none
note: icons の無い項目は icons 空 (任意の欄が無い)

test: Given a malformed icon, when the client lists tools, then the protocol violation is raised
note: 壊れた icon (src 無し, 型違い, theme 不正, sizes 型違い, 配列でない) は McpProtocolError

test: Given a resource link with icons, when it is written back, then its icons are in the block and a link without icons has no icons key
note: resource link の書き戻しで icons が入る。icons の無い link は icons キーを持たない

test: Given https and base64 image data uris, when screened, then they are kept
note: https と base64 の画像 data URI は残る

test: Given unsafe schemes, when screened, then every one is dropped
note: 危険な scheme (javascript, file, http, 非 base64 data など) はすべて落とす

test: Given a server origin, when screened, then an https icon from another origin is dropped and data stays
note: 別 origin の https は落とし data は残す。:443 は既定ポートで同一 origin、別ポート・サフィックス偽装は別 origin

test: Given scheme and host in other letter cases, when screened, then they are compared case-insensitively
note: scheme と host の大文字小文字違いを同一視 (表記の違い)

test: Given an Implementation that is not a JSON object, when it is parsed, then the protocol violation is raised
note: JSON オブジェクトでない Implementation は McpShapeError

test: Given a server with a full identity, when each legacy version initializes, then serverInfo has the fields of that version
note: 各 legacy 版で serverInfo の欄が版ごとに違う (title/description/websiteUrl/icons)

test: Given a server with only a name and version, when it initializes, then serverInfo has only those
note: name と version だけの server は追加欄を送らない (任意の欄が無い)

test: Given a server with a full identity, when a 2026-07-28 client asks to discover, then serverInfo in _meta has every field
note: 2026-07-28 の discover で _meta の serverInfo が全欄を持つ

test: Given a client with a full identity, when it initializes in each legacy version, then clientInfo has the fields of that version
note: 各 legacy 版で clientInfo の欄が版ごとに違う

test: Given a client with a full identity, when it sends a 2026-07-28 request, then _meta carries every field
note: 2026-07-28 の要求の _meta が clientInfo の全欄を持つ

test: Given a client that describes itself, when it initializes, then the server keeps what it said
note: 自己記述した clientInfo を server が保持

test: Given a clientInfo field of the wrong type, when the client initializes, then the server answers invalid params
note: clientInfo の欄の型違い (title: 5) は invalid params -32602 で未初期化のまま

test: Given a server that describes itself in the handshake, when the client connects, then serverInfo holds what the server said
note: server が handshake で述べた serverInfo を client が保持

test: Given a server whose serverInfo has a field of the wrong type, when the client connects, then the connection fails with a protocol error
note: serverInfo の欄の型違いで接続が McpProtocolError で失敗

test: Given a 2026-07-28 server that describes itself, when the client discovers it, then serverInfo holds what it said
note: 2026-07-28 server の discover 結果の serverInfo を保持

test: Given a server with a full identity, when each legacy version initializes, then serverInfo has the fields of that version
note: title は title 対応版だけに現れる。IDごとの区別なし (IMPL-1 と同じ本体)

test: Given a client with a full identity, when it initializes in each legacy version, then clientInfo has the fields of that version
note: clientInfo の title が対応版だけ。IDごとの区別なし (IMPL-2 と同じ本体)

test: Given a server with a full identity, when each legacy version initializes, then serverInfo has the fields of that version
note: icons は icons 対応版だけに現れる。IDごとの区別なし (IMPL-1 と同じ本体)

test: Given a client with a full identity, when it initializes in each legacy version, then clientInfo has the fields of that version
note: clientInfo の icons が対応版だけ。IDごとの区別なし (IMPL-2 と同じ本体)

test: Given a schema without $schema, when its dialect is asked, then it is 2020-12
note: $schema が無いと 2020-12 (任意の欄が無い)

test: Given $schema naming 2020-12, when its dialect is asked, then it is 2020-12
Given $schema naming draft-07 with or without the empty fragment, when its dialect is asked, then it is draft-07
note: draft-07 は末尾の空フラグメントの有無どちらでも同じ (表記の違い)

test: Given a prefixItems schema, when validated as 2020-12 and as draft-07, then only 2020-12 reads it
note: prefixItems を 2020-12 は読み draft-07 は読まない (版による違い)。読む側は不適合を報告

test: Given an array items in draft-07, when validated, then the items are positional
note: draft-07 の配列 items は位置対応 (版による形)。additionalItems false で超過を拒否

test: Given $schema naming an unknown dialect, when an instance is validated, then the dialect is reported unsupported
note: 未知の dialect は UnsupportedDialectError

test: Given $schema that is not a string, when an instance is validated, then the schema is invalid
note: $schema が文字列でないと InvalidSchemaError

test: Given a $ref that leaves the document or points at nothing, when validated, then it is reported
note: 文書外への $ref は UnsupportedKeywordError、行き先が無い $ref は InvalidSchemaError

test: Given a keyword that is not implemented, when validated, then it is reported, not skipped
note: 未実装のキーワードは黙って通さず UnsupportedKeywordError

test: Given a keyword of the wrong JSON type, when validated, then the schema is invalid
note: キーワードの JSON 型違いは InvalidSchemaError

test: Given a type list with a member that is not a string, when a matching instance is validated, then the schema is invalid
note: type 配列に文字列でない要素があると InvalidSchemaError

test: Given a count keyword, when it is 0, 2.0, 2.5 or negative, then 0 and 2.0 are read and the others are invalid
note: 件数キーワードの 0 は受理・負数は不正 (0 と負の境目)。2.0 は整数値の小数として読む、2.5 は不正

test: Given a $ref whose index step names nothing, when validated, then the schema is invalid
note: $ref の添字が行き先を持たない (存在しないキー・空・非数) と InvalidSchemaError

test: Given a $ref that points at nothing inside a property, when an instance is validated, then the schema is invalid
note: property 内の行き先の無い $ref で InvalidSchemaError

test: Given a $ref that comes back to itself, when validated, then the schema is invalid and no limit is reported
note: 自己参照する $ref ループは InvalidSchemaError で上限エラーではない (循環)

test: Given multipleOf, when the divisor is not above zero, then the schema is invalid and no limit is reported
note: multipleOf の約数が 0 以下 (0, -2, 0.0) は不正 (0 より大きいことの境目)

test: Given required with a member that is not a string, when validated, then the schema is invalid
note: required に文字列でない要素があると InvalidSchemaError

test: Given a $ref whose array index has a leading zero, when validated, then the schema is invalid (RFC 6901)
note: $ref の配列添字が先頭ゼロ (00, 01) だと不正 (RFC 6901 の表記)。0 は受理

test: Given an infinite number, when validated against integer and number, then it is a number but no integer
note: 無限大は number だが integer でない (特殊な値)

test: Given const arrays, when the instance differs in length or in an item, then it does not conform
note: const 配列は長さ違い・要素違いを不適合にする

test: Given const objects, when the instance differs in size, in a key or in a value, then it does not conform
note: const オブジェクトはキー順が違っても適合 (順序の入れ替え)。サイズ・キー・値の違いは不適合

test: Given 1 and 1.0, when compared by const and enum in either direction, then they are the same number
note: 1 と 1.0 は const・enum で同じ数 (表記の違い)。1.5 や 2 は別

test: Given integers at the edge of 64 bits, when compared with doubles, then equal values match and neighbours do not
note: int64 の最小・最大と double の境目。等しい値は一致し隣は不一致

test: Given uniqueItems, when two items are the same value however spelled, then the array does not conform
note: uniqueItems は 1 と 1.0、キー順違いのオブジェクトを同じ値とみなす (表記の違い)

test: Given uniqueItems, when items of different type or content could be told apart only by a part of their text, then they are distinct
note: 文字列化すると衝突しそうな別の値 (キー連結など) を別物と判定 (珍しい入力)

test: Given minLength and maxLength, when the length is at, below or above the bound, then the bound itself conforms
note: minLength/maxLength の境目 (ちょうど・1 つ下/上・0)

test: Given a string of multibyte characters, when its length is bounded, then characters are counted, not bytes
note: 文字数は code point で数える (日本語・絵文字)。ちょうど上限・下限の値を含む

test: Given minItems and maxItems, when the size is at the bound, then it conforms and one beyond does not
note: minItems/maxItems の境目 (ちょうど・1 つ超・0)

test: Given contains with minContains and maxContains, when the number of matches is at or beyond a bound, then the bounds are inclusive
note: minContains/maxContains の境目 (ちょうど・1 つ超・0)

test: Given minProperties and maxProperties, when the size is at the bound, then it conforms and one beyond does not
note: minProperties/maxProperties の境目 (ちょうど・1 つ超・0)

test: Given a $ref into an array, when validated, then the element is the target
note: $ref が配列要素を指す (添字)

test: Given a $ref with sibling keywords, when validated, then 2020-12 applies them and draft-07 ignores them
note: $ref の兄弟キーは 2020-12 では適用、draft-07 では無視 (版による違い)

test: Given multipleOf with a decimal divisor, when the quotient carries rounding error, then the decimal multiples still conform
note: 10 進の約数で商に丸め誤差が出ても倍数を適合とする

test: Given minContains or maxContains without contains, or in draft-07, when validated, then they assert nothing
note: contains の無い min/maxContains や draft-07 では何も主張しない (版による違い・珍しい形)

test: Given patternProperties, when a property matches a pattern, then additionalProperties does not apply to it
note: patternProperties に合う property には additionalProperties が及ばない

test: Given dependencies in 2020-12, when validated, then they assert nothing
note: 2020-12 では dependencies は何も主張しない (版による違い)

test: Given draft-07 dependencies as a list of names, when validated, then a present key demands the others
note: draft-07 の dependencies (名前の配列) は存在するキーが他を要求

test: Given dependentSchemas in draft-07, when validated, then the keyword is ignored and dependencies is read
note: draft-07 では dependentSchemas を無視し dependencies を読む (版による違い)

test: Given a $schema that only contains a name after a leading #, when validated, then the dialect is unsupported
note: # の後ろに名前だけを持つ $schema は未対応 dialect (特殊な表記)

test: Given a version above the build default, when a server is created with it, then ValueError is raised
note: [迷い] ビルド既定を超える版で server 生成が ValueError。既定の 1 つ上を含む全部を回すが、ちょうど既定を許す側は確かめない

test: Given a version above the build default, when a client is created with it, then ValueError is raised
note: [迷い] ビルド既定を超える版で client 生成が ValueError。同上

test: Given a server, when a client requests a version the server speaks, then the response carries the same version
note: server が話せる版を要求されたら同じ版を返す

test: Given a server, when a client requests an unknown version, then the response carries the server's latest legacy version
note: 未知の版 (2099-01-01) を要求されると server の最新 legacy 版を返す (拒否ではなく対案)

test: Given a server limited to 2024-11-05, when a client requests a newer version, then the response carries 2024-11-05
note: 2024-11-05 止まりの server は新しい版の要求にも 2024-11-05 を返す (server 側の上限)

test: Given a client limited to 2024-11-05, when the server answers with a newer version, then connect fails naming that version
note: 2024-11-05 止まりの client は新しい版を返されると ValueError で失敗

test: Given a client, when the server answers with an unknown version, then connect fails naming that version
note: 未知の版を返されると ValueError で失敗

test: Given a client newer than the server, when it connects, then both settle on the server's version
note: server より新しい client は server の版で合意

test: Given a server, when initialize has no protocolVersion, then it answers invalid params
note: protocolVersion 欠落で invalid params -32602

test: Given a server, when initialize carries a non-string protocolVersion, then it answers invalid params
note: protocolVersion が文字列でないと -32602

test: Given a server, when initialize has no params or params that are no object, then it answers invalid params
note: params が無い・配列・文字列だと -32602

test: Given a server, when initialize carries a clientInfo that is no Implementation, then it answers invalid params naming clientInfo
note: clientInfo が Implementation でないと -32602 で clientInfo を名指し

test: Given a server, when initialize omits capabilities, then it still answers with a result
note: capabilities を省いた initialize でも結果を返す (任意の欄が無い)

test: Given a server that declares only tools, when it answers initialize, then no other capability key is present
note: tools だけを宣言する server は他の capability キーを返さない

test: Given a server, when initialize carries null for a capability, then it treats the capability as not declared
note: capability が null のときは未宣言扱い (null 値)

test: Given a server, when initialize declares capabilities as objects, then the server records each of them
note: capabilities をオブジェクトで宣言すると server が各々を記録

test: Given a server, when initialize declares sampling features and extensions that are no objects, then the server counts them as not declared
note: オブジェクトでない sampling 内の項目・elicitation・experimental・extensions は未宣言扱いで無視 (型違いの値)

test: Given a client limited to a legacy version, when it connects, then initialize offers that version as a string
note: legacy 版に限った client は initialize でその版を文字列で提示 (各 legacy 版)

test: Given a client that declares only roots, when it connects, then initialize carries no other capability key
note: roots だけ宣言する client は他の capability キーを送らない

test: Given a legacy client, when the handshake completes, then it sends notifications/initialized
note: handshake 完了後に notifications/initialized を送る

test: Given a client attached to a transport, when initialize is called, then it returns the capabilities the server declared
note: transport に attach して initialize を呼ぶと server の capabilities を返す

test: Given a legacy client, when it pings with a string id or an integer id, then the answer is an empty result of JSON-RPC 2.0 under the same id
note: ping の id が文字列でも整数でも同じ id で空の result を返す

test: Given a session that has sent initialize, when it sends initialize again, then the answer is invalid request and the first handshake stands
note: initialize の再送は invalid request -32600 で最初の handshake が維持される

test: Given a tasks capability that supports list only, when written, then it declares no requests
note: list だけの tasks capability は requests を宣言しない。空の capability は空オブジェクト (空)

test: Given a tasks capability that supports a request type, when written, then it names that type under requests
note: 要求種別を持つ tasks capability は requests 下にその型を書く

test: Given a server's versions and capabilities, when the discover result is built, then it matches the specification's example
Given a server that also speaks legacy versions, when the discover result is built, then versions are listed newest first
Given instructions, when the discover result is built, then it carries them, and omits the field when there are none
note: instructions が無いとき欄ごと省かれる (任意の欄が無い)

test: Given a tools/call result, when completed, then it gains resultType and the server identity but no cache fields
Given results with each resultType, when classified, then absent means complete and unknown values are unknown
note: resultType の欠落・未知の値・数値型 (珍しい値) の分類

test: Given no result or a result that is not an object, when classified, then it is complete
note: 結果が無い・オブジェクトでない場合も complete 扱い

test: Given a result that is not a JSON object, when completed, then it is refused as a programming error
note: オブジェクトでない結果は AssertionDefect

test: Given a tools/list result and a cache policy, when completed, then it carries that policy
Given a cacheable result and no policy, when completed, then it is marked not reusable and private
Given a result whose handler already set cache fields, when completed, then the handler's values are kept
note: ハンドラが先に置いた cache 欄が優先される (既存値の保持)

test: Given a _meta without a string protocol version, when headers are built, then there is no version header
note: _meta に文字列の版が無い・数値の版のとき、版ヘッダを付けない (誤った入力の無視)。_meta が空という珍しい形

test: Given params that do not hold a string where Mcp-Name mirrors, when asked for the source, then there is none
note: 文字列でない params や name:5 のとき出所なし (誤った入力)

test: Given a method that carries no Mcp-Name, when asked for the source, then there is none even if params has an empty key
note: Mcp-Name を持たないメソッドでは params に空キーがあっても出所なし (珍しい入力)

test: Given the extension methods, when asked without saying the extension is served, then Mcp-Name is not required
note: 拡張メソッドは拡張を提供すると言わない限り Mcp-Name 不要 (提供有無で変わる)

test: Given a tasks/get with no Mcp-Name, when checked without saying the extension is served, then the headers agree
note: 拡張を提供すると言わない場合は一致、言った場合は Mcp-Name 欠落で不一致。提供フラグの有無で変わる

test: Given a sentinel with more than two pad characters, when decoded, then the header is malformed
note: パディング 2 文字が上限。3 文字 (A===) は上限の 1 つ上で不正

test: Given a sentinel whose payload uses the URL-safe alphabet, when decoded, then the header is malformed
note: URL-safe 文字集合のペイロードは不正

test: Given the empty value, when encoded and decoded, then it stays plain
note: 空文字列 (0) のエンコード・デコード

test: Given values that only partly look like the sentinel, when encoded and decoded, then they stay plain
note: 番兵の一部だけに似た値 (=?base64?abc など) は平文のまま

test: Given the sentinel around an empty payload, when decoded, then it is the empty value, and when that text is a value, then it is Base64
note: 空ペイロードの番兵 (=?base64??=) は空値。その文字列自体が値なら Base64。空ペイロードの境目

test: Given the specification's InputRequiredResult examples, when parsed, then requests and state are read
Given the specification's input requests, when the payload is built, then it equals the specification's result
Given results that are not an InputRequiredResult, when parsed, then each is rejected
Given input requests, when compared with a client's capabilities, then the undeclared ones are named
note: 未宣言の機能の名指し。capabilities が空・nil の場合

test: Given original params, when a retry is built, then the responses are added, the state is echoed exactly and the original stays
note: state の前後の空白・== をそのまま返す。元の params は変わらない。state が無ければ欄を付けない

test: Given params that are nil or not an object, when the input fields are read, checked or a retry is built, then nothing is carried, nothing is rejected and the retry holds only what was added
note: params が nil・オブジェクトでない場合は何も運ばず何も拒否しない

test: Given something that is not an InputRequests map, when validated, then each reason is given
Given a tool that needs input, when it is called, then the answer is input_required with the request and the state
Given a retry with the answers and the state, when the tool runs again, then it sees both and completes
note: retry が求められていない応答 (unrequested) を含んでいても完了する

test: Given a retry that answers only some requests, when the tool runs, then only the missing ones are asked again
Given a handler that asks only to retry with a state, when it is called, then the answer carries the state alone
note: inputRequests が無く state だけを返す

test: Given a client that did not declare the capability a request needs, when the tool asks, then the answer is the missing-capability error
Given a handler that asks for nothing, when it is called, then it is an internal error
Given prompts/get and resources/read, when their handlers need input, then they answer input_required too
Given a request that does not support input_required, when its handler asks, then it is an internal error
Given inputResponses or requestState of the wrong type, when the request arrives, then it is invalid params
Given a version without multi round-trips, when a handler asks for input, then it is an internal error and the fields are ignored
note: 複数往復を持たない版では handler が入力を求めると内部エラー、欄は無視される (版によって違う形)

test: Given a request with trace context, when the server asks for input, then each input request carries it
Given a sealed state, when opened for the same request, then the payload comes back
note: salient の鍵の順序が入れ替わっても同じ要求として開ける

test: Given a state, when it is tampered with, signed by another key, expired or presented elsewhere, then each is rejected with its reason
Given a state that is not acceptable, when a handler opens it, then the peer gets invalid params without the reason
Given a key shorter than the minimum, when sealing, then it raises ValueError
Given a state that is not acceptable, when a handler opens it, then the method and the reason go to stderr
Given payloads that make plain base64 use + and /, when sealed, then the state holds only URL-safe characters
note: + と / を生む payload でも state は URL-safe 文字だけになる

test: Given a state that has no signature part, an empty body or a body that is not what the server seals, when verified, then it is malformed and never accepted
Given a state sealed at a time with a lifetime, when verified at the last second of it and the second after, then the first is accepted and the second expired
note: 有効期間の最後の秒 (1060) は受理、その次の秒 (1061) は期限切れ

test: Given a key of exactly the minimum length, when a state is sealed and verified, then it works, and one byte less is refused by both
note: 最小の鍵長ちょうど (16 バイト) は動き、1 バイト短いと封印も検証も拒否

test: Given an input_required answer, when the client has the handler, then it answers and retries with a new id until the request completes
Given a result with requests only, when the client retries, then no requestState is sent
note: requests だけの結果では、元の params に requestState があっても retry に付けない

test: Given a result with only a state, when the client retries, then it retries at once echoing the state
note: state だけの結果ではすぐに retry して state を返す

test: Given a server that keeps asking, when the limit is reached, then the client raises McpInputRoundsError
note: maxInputRounds=3 で打ち切り、要求は 4 回 (上限ちょうど)

test: Given a request for a capability the client did not declare, when the server asks, then the client raises without calling a handler or retrying
Given an elicitation request, when the client declared no elicitation, then it raises McpProtocolError
Given a declared capability with no handler, when the server asks, then the client raises McpUnsupportedError
Given a handler that answers with an error, when the server asks, then the request is abandoned with McpRequestError
Given input_required for a request that does not allow it, when it arrives, then the client raises McpProtocolError
Given an input_required result that is malformed, when it arrives, then the client raises McpProtocolError
Given a slow answer to the input requests, when the request has a timeout, then the timeout counts each attempt and not the answering
note: 入力の応答が遅い (120ms) とき、timeout (60ms) は各試行だけを数え応答待ちは数えない

test: Given a handler whose input request breaks the rules of its method, when it is called, then it is an internal error and nothing is asked
Given input requests whose params break the rules of their method, when checked, then each problem names its request
note: 規則どおりの要求は問題なし、破るものは要求名つきで報告

test: Given a URL elicitation or sampling with tools, when compared with a client's capabilities, then the mode and the tools must be declared too
note: URL モード・tools つき sampling は宣言を要する。宣言があれば通る

test: Given a client that declared elicitation without the url mode, when the tool asks for a page, then the missing-capability error names the mode
note: url モード未宣言は欠落機能にモードを名指す。宣言があれば input_required

test: Given a client that declared sampling without tools, when the tool asks the model with tools, then the missing-capability error names the tools
note: tools 未宣言は欠落機能に tools を名指す。宣言があれば input_required

test: Given a URL elicitation, when the client declared only the form mode, then it raises without calling the handler or retrying
Given a form elicitation, when the client's handler accepts, then the retry carries the ElicitResult
Given a form elicitation, when the client's handler answers outside the schema, then the request is abandoned and nothing is retried
Given a tool with x-mcp-header, when a call carries the matching header, then the answer is 200
Given a tool with x-mcp-header, when the header differs from the body, then the answer is 400 header mismatch
Given a tool with x-mcp-header, when the call omits the header though the body has the value, then the answer is 400 header mismatch
Given a tool with x-mcp-header, when the argument is absent and so is the header, then the answer is 200
note: 引数もヘッダも無い (任意の欄が無い)

test: Given a tool with x-mcp-header, when the argument is null and the header is absent, then the answer is 200
note: 引数が null でヘッダが無い (null は不在扱い)

test: Given a tool with x-mcp-header, when the header is sent without the argument, then the answer is 400 header mismatch
Given a Base64 header, when it decodes to the body value, then the answer is 200
Given a Base64 header without its padding, when posted, then the answer is 400 header mismatch
Given a tool without x-mcp-header, when a Mcp-Param header is sent, then it is ignored
note: x-mcp-header の無い tool に付いた Mcp-Param ヘッダは無視される

test: Given a tool whose x-mcp-header is invalid, when tools are listed, then the server does not publish it
note: 不正な x-mcp-header の tool は公開されず、有効な tool は残る

test: Given a server that lists an invalid tool, when the client lists tools, then the invalid tool is excluded and the others stay
note: クライアントも不正な tool を除き他は残す

test: Given a client that listed tools, when it calls one with x-mcp-header, then the request carries Mcp-Param-Region
Given a scripted server, when a client calls a tool listed with x-mcp-header, then the headers are exactly the specification's
note: 引数が無いときはヘッダを付けない、整数・真偽値・前後に空白のある文字列 (Base64) の形

test: Given a call whose integer argument is beyond the safe range, when it is sent, then the transport refuses it before the wire
note: 安全な整数の範囲 (2^53-1) の 1 つ上 (2^53) の整数引数を送信前に拒否

test: Given a tool that gained x-mcp-header after it was listed, when the call is refused as a header mismatch, then the client lists the tools again and retries with the header
note: listing 後に tool が x-mcp-header を得た場合に再 listing して再送する (途中で変わる)

test: Given a call that is refused as a header mismatch again after the tools were listed again, when it is answered, then the error is returned and the client does not retry a second time
Given a tool call that the server answers, when it is sent over HTTP, then the client does not read the tool list again
Given a header mismatch and a tool list that cannot be read, when the call is refused, then the refusal is returned without a retry
Given a header mismatch and a tool list without the tool, when the call is refused, then the refusal is returned without a retry
Given a header mismatch and a tool listed on the second page, when the call is refused, then the client reads on and retries
note: tool が 2 ページ目にあるとき最後まで読んで再送 (ページ分割)

test: Given a header mismatch and a tool list whose nextCursor is not a string, when the call is refused, then the client stops reading and returns the refusal
Given a header mismatch and a server whose tool list never ends, when the call is refused, then the client gives up reading and returns the refusal
Given a call that does not name 2026-07-28, when it is sent after the tool was listed, then it carries no Mcp-Param header
note: 2026-07-28 を名乗らない呼び出し (_meta 無し、空、数値の版、旧版、未知の版) には Mcp-Param ヘッダを付けない

test: Given a 2026-07-28 tools/call without a tool name, when it is sent, then it is posted without Mcp-Param headers
note: tool 名が無い・数値の tools/call は Mcp-Param ヘッダ無しで送る

test: Given a tools/list that failed, when its id is used again by another request, then that answer is not read as a tool list
note: 失敗した tools/list の id を別の要求が再使用する (id の重複)

test: Given a tools/list answer without a tools member, when the client reads it, then the answer is handed over as it is
note: tools メンバの無い tools/list 応答はそのまま渡す (任意の欄が無い)

test: Given a tools/list answer whose tools member is no array, when the client reads it, then the answer is handed over as it is
note: tools が配列でない応答はそのまま渡す (壊れた応答)

test: Given a tool listed with x-mcp-header, when the next listing declares it invalid, then a call no longer carries the header
note: 次の listing が不正と宣言した tool には以後ヘッダを付けない (状態が途中で変わる)

test: Given a tool listed with x-mcp-header, when the next listing no longer declares it, then a call no longer carries the header
note: 次の listing が宣言をやめた tool には以後ヘッダを付けない (状態が途中で変わる)
